visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a TAP Air Portugal airplane nose inside a large indoor complex. A woman and man stand with three children; one boy in a striped shirt looks into the camera excitedly while pointing at the plane. (2) The family enters an indoor miniature city with stone-paved streets and a Santander bank. The children stand at a white counter to exchange paper vouchers for play money, which they hold up with surprised expressions. (3) The children walk through a street passing a McDonald's and an iServices store. A boy receives a driver's license card from a staff member at an office. (4) The kids put on red fire department vests and climb onto a miniature red fire truck. A large group of children in similar vests gathers under a large artificial tree to watch a staff member rescue a stuffed dog. (5) A young girl sits at a pink and white beauty salon table while a staff member paints her nails pink. (6) The two boys put on green military flight suits and sit on a bench inside an Air Force-themed room. They later climb into a small helicopter cockpit simulator. (7) The family visits a Lidl supermarket. One boy sits behind a checkout counter acting as a cashier while the other children load toy groceries onto the belt. (8) In the final scene, the kids show their earned play money to their parents in the street; the mother smiles and reaches for the bills as the children laugh.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy pop BGM track with synthesized drums and a bright keyboard melody starts immediately. A female voice speaks in an excited, narrative tone over ambient indoor echoes and distant crowd chatter. (2) A young boy's voice shouts enthusiastically in the foreground. This is followed by the sound of paper money rustling and several rapid 'ding' sound effects. (3) A digital 'whoosh' transition occurs. A male voice interjects with a low, casual comment. This phase includes the sound of high-pitched electronic 'beeps' mimicking a license scanner. (4) The BGM continues as a backdrop to a group of children cheering and laughing loudly. There is a distinct 'thud' sound as a child moves in a plastic seat. (5) A series of digital UI 'pop' sound effects occur in the supermarket segment, timed with toy groceries being scanned. The rustling of plastic bags is clearly audible. (6) The video ends with a conversational interplay between the female narrator and the male adult, filled with laughter. The music swells in volume before a quick fade-out.
